name: 彭尉祖
objective: This course focuses on numerical methods for solving thermal problems, with an emphasis on theoretical formulation and practical implementation using computational software. The topic covers fundamental heat transfer, including conduction in steady-state and transient scenarios, natural and forced convection, and radiative heat transfer.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to Numerical Heat Transfer
Week 2: Fundamentals of Heat Transfer
Week 3: Conservation of Mass, Momentum, Energy
Week 4: Boundary & Initial Conditions
Week 5: Theoretical Transient Heat Conduction
Week 6: Fin Conduction–Convection
Week 7: Boundary Layers
Week 8: External & Internal Flow
Week 9: Midterm exam
Week 10: Numerical Methods Fundamentals
Week 11: Mesh & Grid Independence
Week 12: Software Environment
Week 13: Case Study: Transient Heat Conduction
Week 14: Case Study: Fully Developed Duct Flow
Week 15: Case Study: Fin Conduction–Convection
Week 16: Case Study: LEDs
Week 17: Case Study: Electronics on PCB
Week 18: Final exam
materials: Yunus Cengel, Afshin J. Ghajar, “Heat and Mass Transfer: Fundamentals and Applications,” 6th ed., ISBN 9789863415121. McGraw-Hill Education, New York, United States of America, 2024.
